tailoring.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Java, Spring & SAP Commerce Cloud Developer
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker, Kubernetes and agile delivery. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Software Engineer
cover_en.hook: I am very excited to apply for the Senior Software Engineer position, bringing over 5 years of hands-on backend and e-commerce platform expertise gained at Rockwell Automation and Shell. My strong technical foundation in Java, Spring, and API integrations aligns perfectly with your engineering needs.

bullets.label: Enterprise E-Commerce Platforms
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management following best practices.

bullets.label: RESTful APIs & Headless Integration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services (headless APIs) and built custom Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for seamless data flows with storefronts and third-party consumers.

bullets.label: Data Pipelines & Integrations
bullets.text: Designed and optimized complex PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub, resolving integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM, and e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & Technical Leadership
bullets.text: Collaborated closely with international business and technical stakeholders to analyze requirements, write functional specifications, perform code reviews, and support production environments.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, and I am available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my background matches your team.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to bring my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and backend development expertise to Valine Sonal Noronha's engineering initiatives. My strong background in building scalable Java applications, RESTful APIs, and complex data integrations at companies like Rockwell Automation and Shell enables me to hit the ground running and immediately contribute to high-performance platform delivery.
tailoring.motivation_short: I bring 5+ years of robust backend and e-commerce platform engineering experience, specializing in Java, Spring, and scalable integrations, ready to deliver immediate value to your team.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi Valine, I saw your posting for a Senior Software Engineer. With 5+ years of hands-on backend and enterprise e-commerce development experience (Java, Spring, REST APIs) at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested. I have a valid German work permit and can start on Dec 16, 2026.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior Software Engineer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Software Engineer position. With over 5 years of professional backend development and enterprise e-commerce experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, and complex platform integrations.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit, and I am available starting 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my background fits your team.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
